name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Convert local PDFs into polished standalone card-based HTML readers with PDF-inspired styling and embedded table and figure images.
long_description: PDF Card Reader is a local-first MCP tool for turning dense PDFs into minimal HTML readers inspired by the source document. It keeps text local, renders source pages, crops detected tables and figures as images, derives safe reader styling from the PDF palette, and writes a standalone HTML file that can be moved across devices. Optional sampling asks the host LLM for validated style-token choices or boundary-only card polish operations without raw CSS or source-text rewrites.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_card_html
tools.description: Convert a local PDF into a standalone card-based HTML reader with PDF-inspired styling and embedded table and figure images. Set style_engine='sampling' for validated host-selected style tokens or postprocess_engine='sampling' for validated card boundary polish.
